why: issue 2036 (2026-10-25): the `publisher_gid` member of `cpp:RmwMessageInfo`. It has upstream `rmw_gid_t`'s members (`implementation_identifier`, `data[24]`) under our name, because the C++ surface does not include the RMW ABI headers that define the C type. `implementation_identifier` is null. How many of the 24 bytes mean anything depends on the backend; see `rust:MessageInfo`.
